q: The cells in the ____ layers are not tightly packed and have many spaces around them filled with air.
e: The cells in the mesophyll layers are not tightly packed and have many spaces around them filled with air. That missing piece is mesophyll.

q: The walls of the mesophyll cells are wet and some of this water evaporates into the air space, so that the air inside the leaf is usually ____ with water vapour.
e: The walls of the mesophyll cells are wet and some of this water evaporates into the air space, so that the air inside the leaf is usually saturated with water vapour. The blank is saturated.

q: The air in the internal spaces of the leaf has directly contacted with the air outside the leaf, through small pores called ____.
e: The air in the internal spaces of the leaf has directly contacted with the air outside the leaf, through small pores called stomata. That missing piece is stomata.

q: If there is a ____ between the air inside the leaf (higher water potential) and the air outside of the leaf (lower water potential), then water vapour will diffuse out of the leaf down this gradient.
e: If there is a water potential gradient between the air inside the leaf (higher water potential) and the air outside of the leaf (lower water potential), then water vapour will diffuse out of the leaf down this gradient. The blank is water potential gradient.

q: In condition of low ____, the gradient is steep, so transpiration takes place more quickly than in high humidity.
e: In condition of low humidity, the gradient is steep, so transpiration takes place more quickly than in high humidity. That missing piece is humidity.

q: Transpiration rate may also be increased by an increasing in ____ or rising in temperature.
e: Transpiration rate may also be increased by an increasing in wind speed or rising in temperature. That missing piece is wind speed.

q: In most plants, stomata open during the day and close at ____.
e: In most plants, stomata open during the day and close at night. Write night in the gap.

q: Stomata must be opened during the day to allow ____ to diffuse into the leaf for photosynthesis.
e: Stomata must be opened during the day to allow carbon dioxide to diffuse into the leaf for photosynthesis. That missing piece is carbon dioxide.

q: In especially dry conditions, when the water potential gradient between the internal air spaces and the external air is steep, a plant may have to compromise by partially or completely closing its ____ to prevent its leaves drying out.
e: In especially dry conditions, when the water potential gradient between the internal air spaces and the external air is steep, a plant may have to compromise by partially or completely closing its stomata to prevent its leaves drying out. That missing piece is stomata.

q: In hot conditions, transpiration plays an important role in ____ the leaves.
e: In hot conditions, transpiration plays an important role in cooling the leaves. Write cooling in the gap.

q: If the rate at which water vapour is lost by transpiration ____ the rate at which a plant can take up water from the soil, then the amount of water in its cells decreases.
e: If the rate at which water vapour is lost by transpiration exceeds the rate at which a plant can take up water from the soil, then the amount of water in its cells decreases. Write exceeds in the gap.

q: The cells become less turgid and the plant ____ as the soft parts such as leaves loose the support provided turgid cells.
e: The cells become less turgid and the plant wilts as the soft parts such as leaves loose the support provided turgid cells. The blank is wilts.

q: Ascent of sap mostly occurs due to ____ exerted transpiration of water.
e: Ascent of sap mostly occurs due to transpiration pull exerted transpiration of water. That missing piece is transpiration pull.

q: The development of ____ tissue, which is essential for providing rigidity and strength to the plant, is favoured by the increase in transpiration.
e: The development of mechanical tissue, which is essential for providing rigidity and strength to the plant, is favoured by the increase in transpiration. That missing piece is mechanical.

q: Mineral salts are mostly distributed by rising column of ____.
e: Mineral salts are mostly distributed by rising column of sap. Write sap in the gap.

q: Transpiration helps in better development of ____ system, which is required for support, and absorption of mineral salts.
e: Transpiration helps in better development of root system, which is required for support, and absorption of mineral salts. The blank is root.

q: The ash and ____ content of the fruit increases with the increase in transpiration.
e: The ash and sugar content of the fruit increases with the increase in transpiration. Write sugar in the gap.

q: Excessive transpiration induces hardening and resistant to moderate ____.
e: Excessive transpiration induces hardening and resistant to moderate drought. The blank is drought.

q: Transpiration helps the shape and structure of plant parts by keeping cells ____.
e: Transpiration helps the shape and structure of plant parts by keeping cells turgid. Write turgid in the gap.

q: As water evaporates through the stomata, it results in pulling of water, molecule by molecule into the leaf from the ____.
e: As water evaporates through the stomata, it results in pulling of water, molecule by molecule into the leaf from the xylem. That missing piece is xylem.

q: A ____ funnel is filled with water and rubber stopper attaches a leafy twig to it in the demonstration of transpiration pull.
e: A thistle funnel is filled with water and rubber stopper attaches a leafy twig to it in the demonstration of transpiration pull. The blank is thistle.

q: Loss of water from the twig(i.e., transpiration) produces a ____ in the thistle funnel and water will be drawn up.
e: Loss of water from the twig(i.e., transpiration) produces a vacuum in the thistle funnel and water will be drawn up. That missing piece is vacuum.
